title: Unit: save, resume and submit a training checklist
summary: Match a published vehicle checklist to its target, record exercise answers and notes, save progress, close and reopen the working run, then submit and verify the returned result.
prerequisites: Authorized Unit access, the intended vehicle selected and an appropriate published vehicle-target training checklist available.
Use a disposable fictional exercise. Engine 51 is selected with Released, No Active Call and one of one roles visible; the existing crew assignment is unchanged.
The captured answers are a software exercise. The reported location is left blank; no administrator setup is demonstrated.

scenes.title: Match the form to the selected vehicle
scenes.capture_intent: Use only the ordered, unmodified reviewed actual Unit source images in this candidate. Voice, media and operation timing remain unassigned.
scenes.narration: Unit checklists help vehicle crews keep each check tied to the right apparatus and form. Here, Engine 51 is selected. Open Checklists and look under Start checklist. Find Engine 51 daily readiness, then choose the Engine 51 button directly beneath it. The Ambulance 61 form offers a same-named target button, so match both the form and vehicle before starting.
scenes.practice: Match both the published form name and target unit before starting an authorized training run.

scenes.title: Answer the first required item
scenes.capture_intent: Use only the ordered, unmodified reviewed actual Unit source images in this candidate. Voice, media and operation timing remain unassigned.
required_labels: TRAINING ONLY - Software walkthrough answer; no physical equipment inspection was performed.
scenes.narration: The form opens for Engine 51, Version 1. Equipment ready for the exercise is the first item, marked Required and Critical. Choose Pass for this training run and add a Note explaining that this is a software walkthrough and no physical inspection was performed. That context makes the simulated answer clear to the next reader. Check the note, then choose Next.
scenes.practice: For a disposable exercise, enter Pass with an explicit software-only note; do not substitute this for an inspection.

scenes.narration: Stock and supplies recorded is item two. Choose Pass and add a supplies-specific note that keeps the answer within the exercise. An item note should explain that particular answer, so the next crew member can understand what was recorded. Confirm the heading and answer, then choose Next. Use the same review habit for a patrol kit or SAR cache with your team's published form.
scenes.practice: Use an appropriate team checklist to review a hypothetical SAR cache or patrol kit; keep its item note specific.

scenes.capture_intent: Use only the ordered, unmodified reviewed actual Unit source images in this candidate. Voice, media and operation timing remain unassigned.
required_labels: TRAINING ONLY - Fictional exercise handover notes reviewed in the software.

scenes.narration: The third item is Handover notes reviewed. Choose Pass and record the fictional handover context in the item's Note. Below the navigation buttons, the general note describes the whole run. Keep its overall training purpose clear; leave the location field blank here. Choose Save progress to save the unfinished run. The sheet stays open, so choose Close to return to the list and review the saved entry.
scenes.practice: Save progress on a disposable exercise, explicitly close the sheet, then find the saved target in History.

scenes.narration: Local drafts now shows Draft 1. Choose History to load the saved run list, then open the timestamped Engine 51 entry. The vehicle and time help you find the work you just saved. Save progress keeps the run available for review before final submission. That matters during handover, when someone needs to check the entered answers before finalizing the record.
scenes.practice: Find the intended saved exercise by target and timestamp; do not infer a submitted result from the list alone.

scenes.narration: The reopened run brings back the first item's Pass answer, equipment note and general note. Read them together and compare them with the intended record before continuing. Save progress and Submit checklist remain available while this is the working run. For a community care vehicle, this review gives the next operator the answer, its explanation and the overall context in one place.
scenes.practice: Reopen saved work in the same tab and verify the visible answer and notes before finalizing it.

scenes.narration: When the review is complete, choose Submit checklist. The sheet changes to Submitted, Score 100. The answer fields are now read-only, and Close remains available. Save progress and Submit checklist are gone. The score is the result of the answers entered in this training form. Read the returned state to confirm that the run has reached submission.
